title: The Lord Promises to Bless Jerusalem

questions.question: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "I am exceedingly jealous for Zion, and with great... I am jealous for her."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:2 (ESV): "I am exceedingly jealous for Zion, and with great wrath I am jealous for her."

questions.question: Thus says the Lord: "I have returned to Zion and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem, and Jerusalem shall be called the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:3 (ESV): "and Jerusalem shall be called the faithful city,"

questions.question: What will the mountain of the Lord of hosts be called?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:3 (ESV): "and the mountain of the Lord of hosts, the holy mountain."

questions.question: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "Old men and old women shall again sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each with..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:4 (ESV): "each with staff in hand because of great age."

questions.question: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls... in its streets.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:5 (ESV): "And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in its streets."

questions.question: Thus says the Lord of hosts: "If it is... in the sight of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be... in my sight, declares the Lord of hosts?"
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:6 (ESV): "If it is marvelous in the sight of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my sight, declares the Lord of hosts?"

questions.question: "Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country, and I will bring them to dwell in the midst of..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:7-8 (ESV): "and I will bring them to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem."

questions.question: "And they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in faithfulness and in..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:8 (ESV): "and I will be their God, in faithfulness and in righteousness."

questions.question: "Let your hands be... you who in these days have been hearing these words from the mouth of the prophets..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:9 (ESV): "Let your hands be strong, you who in these days have been hearing these words"

questions.question: "For there shall be a sowing of... The vine shall give its fruit, and the ground shall give its produce..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:12 (ESV): "For there shall be a sowing of peace."

questions.question: "Speak the truth to one another; render in your gates judgments that are true and make for..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:16 (ESV): "render in your gates judgments that are true and make for peace;"

questions.question: What did the Lord say about the fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months?
options: They shall be seasons of joy and gladness
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be seasons of joy and gladness
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:19 (ESV): "shall be to the house of Judah seasons of joy and gladness and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace."

questions.question: Peoples shall yet come, even the inhabitants of many cities. The inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, "Let us go at once to entreat the favor of the Lord..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:21 (ESV): "saying, 'Let us go at once to entreat the favor of the Lord and to seek the Lord of hosts; I myself am going.'"

questions.question: And how many men from the nations of every tongue shall take hold of the robe of a Jew?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:23 (ESV): "In those days ten men from the nations of every tongue shall take hold of the robe of a Jew,"

questions.question: What will the men from the nations say when they take hold of the Jew's robe?
options: "Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you."
"Teach us the law of your God."
questions.correctAnswer: "Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 8:23 (ESV): "saying, 'Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.'"

key_verse_text: These are the things that you shall do: Speak the truth to one another; render in your gates judgments that are true and make for peace; do not devise evil in your hearts against one another, and love no false oath, for all these things I hate, declares the Lord.
